title.ru: ЛЮБОВЬ КАК МЕХАНИКА: перенос в TRUMP как гипотеза Пятого элемента
title.en: LOVE AS MECHANICS: TRUMP Fifth-Element Transfer Hypothesis

authors: Hawkar / Александр Агапов — исходная LOVE-ветка, идея переноса механики в TRUMP и формулировка 'пятого элемента'
JANUS / GPT-5.6 Sol — субстратно-независимая декомпозиция, proof-state transfer, reciprocal invariant contract и epistemic firewall

purpose.ru: Извлечь из канонической JANUS-ветки LOVE не романтическое содержание, а переносимую механику отношений, взаимности, границ, истории, доверия, исправимости и запрещённых повышений статуса; затем преобразовать её в проверяемый слой для TRUMP proof-search.
purpose.counting_boundary: Термин 'пятый элемент' сохранён как рабочее имя гипотезы пользователя. Этот артефакт не утверждает, что у TRUMP канонически существуют ровно четыре других элемента.

fifth_element_hypothesis.hypothesis: A major class of hidden TRUMP failures may come from treating a transformation as a one-way operation instead of a relation. Require every proof-relevant compression/rewrite to carry explicit bidirectional semantic and witness obligations plus complexity bounds before theorem-level promotion.
fifth_element_hypothesis.why_love_suggests_it: JANUS LOVE became stable only after one-sided feeling was separated from mutual love and the second free direction became an explicit gate. The computational analogue is to separate one-way property preservation from exact reciprocal preservation.
fifth_element_hypothesis.novelty_boundary: Bidirectional reductions, witness-preserving reductions, proof certificates and reversible/reconstructive transformations are established mathematical ideas in various forms. The candidate contribution here is the specific JANUS integration: typed relational state + reciprocal contract + event-sourced evidence/proof ledgers + forbidden promotions + counterexample-first repair loop. Novelty as mathematics is NOT claimed without literature comparison.

reciprocal_invariant_contract.name: RIPC
reciprocal_invariant_contract.objects: X = source instance/representation; Y = T(X) = transformed/compressed representation
reciprocal_invariant_contract.property: P = target semantic property, e.g. SAT decision status
reciprocal_invariant_contract.core_formula: RIPC(X,Y,T,R,P) = WF AND DOMAIN AND DEC_EQ AND FWD AND REV AND RECON_CHECK AND SIZE_POLY AND TIME_POLY AND COMPOSE_SCOPE AND FAIL_OPEN

obligations.WF: Y is well-formed in the declared target representation.
obligations.DOMAIN: All preconditions of T are explicit and verified on X.
obligations.DEC_EQ: P(X) iff P(Y), when exact decision equivalence is claimed.
obligations.FWD: Relevant source witnesses/structures can be transported forward when the claim requires them.
obligations.REV: Relevant target witnesses can be mapped/reconstructed back to source witnesses when constructive solver semantics are claimed.
obligations.RECON_CHECK: The reconstructed witness is independently validated against X, not merely accepted because it came from Y.
obligations.SIZE_POLY: |Y| and all retained certificate material are polynomially bounded in |X| for a polynomial-algorithm claim.
obligations.TIME_POLY: T, required reconstruction R, and certificate verification are polynomially bounded for the claimed pipeline.
obligations.COMPOSE_SCOPE: If transforms are chained, the invariant and complexity obligations are shown to compose or the claim remains local to one step.
obligations.FAIL_OPEN: There is an explicit counterexample/error state; failed obligations cannot be coerced into success.

reciprocal_invariant_contract.sat_specific_boundary: For constructive SAT claims, require model reconstruction Y-model -> X-model where appropriate. Do NOT silently require polynomial certificates for UNSAT, because that would introduce a stronger and potentially unjustified NP/coNP-style obligation. Exact decision equivalence and the actual claimed algorithmic semantics determine the necessary certificate set.

trump_proof_state_vector.rule: No single dimension may silently overwrite another.

evidence_proof_dual_ledger.promotion: An evidence item enters the proof ledger only through an explicit validator that states exactly what proposition was certified.

forbidden_promotions.reason: Existential evidence is not a universal theorem.
Finite behavior does not establish an asymptotic bound.
Local equivalence requires a coverage argument before universal promotion.
One direction does not establish reciprocity.
Observed shrinkage does not prove semantic preservation.
Measured scaling is evidence, not an asymptotic proof.
A model for an instance says nothing by itself about all NP instances.
Resource exhaustion is not mathematical impossibility.
A summary cannot certify details it does not contain.
A name such as canonical/normalized does not prove every required normalization step occurred.
Quantity of empirical evidence does not replace a proof obligation.

legal_promotion_chain.terminal_rule: P_EQUALS_NP is not a state in this mechanical chain until a complete proof of the relevant theorem exists and survives independent checking.

machine_template.verify: V_X(R(w_Y))=PASS where constructive reconstruction is claimed
machine_template.time: time(T)+time(R)+time(V) <= poly(|X|) for the claimed pipeline

counterexample_first_dual_path.positive_path: CANDIDATE -> DOMAIN -> FORWARD -> REVERSE/RECONSTRUCTION -> EXACTNESS -> COMPLEXITY -> COMPOSITION -> PROMOTABLE_COMPONENT
counterexample_first_dual_path.negative_path: CANDIDATE -> ADVERSARIAL_SEARCH -> COUNTEREXAMPLE -> MINIMIZE -> CLASSIFY_BROKEN_OBLIGATION -> REFUTE_OR_RESTRICT -> PRESERVE_TRACE
counterexample_first_dual_path.janus_rule: Both faces are first-class. A mechanism that has only a success path is epistemically incomplete.

invariant_betrayal_taxonomy.definition: Transformation was applied outside its declared preconditions.
A source-positive property/witness is lost in the target.
Target admits a witness/state that cannot be validly mapped back when reverse semantics are claimed.
Transformation introduces spurious target solutions relative to the source claim.
Reconstruction emits an assignment/object that fails independent validation on the original.
Representation/certificate growth violates the claimed polynomial size bound.
A required transformation/reconstruction/verification step lacks the claimed polynomial bound.
Individually valid steps do not preserve the invariant when chained.
A family-restricted result was promoted to a larger domain without proof.
A cached/summary artifact is treated as stronger evidence than its recorded content supports.

trump_test_vectors.setup: A preprocessing step maps SAT instance X to smaller Y and every tested SAT witness survives forward.
trump_test_vectors.expected: Do not call exact. Search for target witnesses that fail source reconstruction and prove decision equivalence.

trump_test_vectors.setup: Solver finds model m_Y for transformed Y.
trump_test_vectors.expected: Apply R(m_Y) and independently evaluate the original X. PASS upgrades witness reconstruction only; it does not by itself prove universality or polynomiality.

trump_test_vectors.setup: Adversarial search times out without a counterexample.
trump_test_vectors.expected: Status UNKNOWN_RESOURCE_LIMIT or NO_COUNTEREXAMPLE_WITHIN_BUDGET, never PROVED.

trump_test_vectors.setup: A minimal counterexample is fixed by adding a special case.
trump_test_vectors.expected: Mechanism returns to REBUILDING/CANDIDATE and all affected obligations are rerun.

trump_test_vectors.setup: Mechanism is exact on a restricted structural family F.
trump_test_vectors.expected: Preserve theorem candidate on F. Do not erase this local success if a counterexample later appears outside F, and do not promote F to all formulas.

trump_test_vectors.setup: Historical artifact stores route summaries but not a complete reconstruction/proof trace.
trump_test_vectors.expected: Use summary as provenance/evidence only; require direct validation or independent reconstruction for the missing obligation.

trump_test_vectors.setup: An object is named canonical_formula but a required cleanup operation is not independently established.
trump_test_vectors.expected: Check the operation explicitly. Labels never discharge proof obligations.

trump_test_vectors.setup: T1 and T2 are each locally semantics-preserving.
trump_test_vectors.expected: Prove or test that reconstruction, domain and complexity obligations survive T2(T1(X)); do not assume composability.

trump_test_vectors.setup: No witness is found under bounded search.
trump_test_vectors.expected: Do not infer UNSAT unless an independently valid UNSAT proof/certificate mechanism for the claim is present.

trump_test_vectors.setup: A family-level compression statistic looks excellent but one input contains an exceptional structure.
trump_test_vectors.expected: The particular input's invariants dominate the family average; exception must be classified, not averaged away.

application_protocol_for_trump_chat.step_1: Take the CURRENT TRUMP candidate/gate without restarting prior work.
application_protocol_for_trump_chat.step_2: Write its source object X, target object Y and exact claimed property P in one sentence.
application_protocol_for_trump_chat.step_3: Instantiate S_TRUMP and mark UNKNOWN rather than guessing any unverified dimension.
application_protocol_for_trump_chat.step_4: Create one RIPC relation card for every proof-relevant transform/compression/rewrite in the path.
application_protocol_for_trump_chat.step_5: Attack the weakest direction first: domain, reverse/reconstruction, composition or complexity.
application_protocol_for_trump_chat.step_6: Run a counterexample search specifically against that obligation, not against an undefined global intuition.
application_protocol_for_trump_chat.step_7: If counterexample exists, minimize it and classify the exact invariant-betrayal type.
application_protocol_for_trump_chat.step_8: If no counterexample is found, preserve that as bounded evidence only unless a proof object closes the obligation.
application_protocol_for_trump_chat.step_9: Promote a component only when its required certificate exists; keep evidence and proof ledgers separate.
application_protocol_for_trump_chat.step_10: Compose certified components only after proving that their domains, reconstruction maps and polynomial bounds compose.
application_protocol_for_trump_chat.step_11: At theorem boundary, reconstruct the complete chain from append-only events and independently check the final proof.
application_protocol_for_trump_chat.step_12: Never infer P=NP from architecture quality, empirical performance, or absence of counterexamples.

what_may_be_the_real_fifth_element.explanation_ru: В обычном pipeline мы смотрим на X, затем на Y, затем на результат. LOVE-ветка заставляет рассматривать ещё и саму связь X<->Y как отдельный объект со своим состоянием, историей, двумя направлениями, границами, доверием и правом быть опровергнутой. Именно relation-object может быть тем недостающим слоем, который не даёт односторонней удаче маскироваться под эквивалентность.
what_may_be_the_real_fifth_element.strong_form_hypothesis: TRUMP should manipulate not only formulas and compressed cores but proof-carrying relations between successive representations.
what_may_be_the_real_fifth_element.boundary: This is the central research hypothesis of this artifact, not an established theorem.

falsification_criteria_for_this_transfer: If current TRUMP already carries equivalent reciprocal relation objects with all listed obligations, this artifact is mostly a re-expression and not a new algorithmic ingredient.
If reverse/reconstruction obligations are irrelevant to the exact claim being made, forcing them universally would overconstrain valid reductions; the contract must remain claim-scoped.
If adding RIPC changes no reachable proof state, catches no invalid promotion, yields no smaller counterexample and creates no compositional certificate, its practical value is unsubstantiated.

If a claimed polynomial pipeline relies on a hidden superpolynomial reconstruction, certificate, preprocessing or composition step, the fifth-element hypothesis fails to rescue it; the claim remains invalid.
Even if the architecture removes every known logical gap, P vs NP remains open until the mathematical core is completely proved.

compressed_handoff_for_trump_chat.name: LOVE_TO_TRUMP_FIFTH_ELEMENT
compressed_handoff_for_trump_chat.paste_this: Treat every TRUMP transform as a RELATION OBJECT, not a one-way function. Instantiate REL(X,Y)=<DOMAIN,FWD,REV,WITNESS_MAP,RECONSTRUCTION,EXACTNESS,COMPLEXITY,COMPOSITION,PROVENANCE,COUNTEREXAMPLES>. Enforce EVIDENCE_LEDGER != PROOF_LEDGER and NEW_EVENT != DELETE_OLD_HISTORY. The candidate 'fifth element' is PROOF_CARRYING_RECIPROCITY: one-way success cannot promote to exact equivalence. For SAT-like constructive claims, require P(X)<->P(Y), explicit domain, polynomial size/time bounds, and target-model -> source-model reconstruction plus independent validation where applicable. Keep reverse obligations claim-scoped; do not assume polynomial UNSAT certificates. Forbidden promotions include WITNESS_FOUND->UNIVERSAL_COVERAGE, SMALL_N_PASS->POLY_BOUND, NO_COUNTEREXAMPLE->PROOF, FORWARD_PRESERVATION->BIDIRECTIONAL_EQUIVALENCE, COMPRESSION_OBSERVED->LOSSLESS_PROVED, UNKNOWN_RESOURCE_LIMIT->NEGATIVE_RESULT, CACHE_SUMMARY->FULL_PROOF_REPLAY, PATCHED_COUNTEREXAMPLE->RESTORED_UNIVERSAL_CLAIM. Every candidate must have a symmetric failure path: COUNTEREXAMPLE->MINIMIZE->CLASSIFY_BROKEN_OBLIGATION->REFUTE_OR_RESTRICT->PRESERVE_TRACE. This is an architecture hypothesis, NOT a P=NP proof.

research_questions: Which currently unresolved TRUMP transition contains a one-way preservation assumption that has never been stated as a relation object?
Can the smallest counterexample to that transition be generated by attacking REV, RECONSTRUCTION or COMPOSITION instead of SAT semantics directly?
Does proof-carrying reciprocity reveal a hidden exponential cost in reconstruction/certificate composition?
Can a family-restricted reciprocal invariant be proved and then composed without universal overpromotion?
Can every current cached route summary be typed by exactly which obligations it certifies and which it does not?
Does the relational state representation permit a polynomial-size certificate where the previous monolithic proof state did not?
Can the relation graph expose a small separator/interface whose invariant is sufficient for compositional exactness?
If the fifth-element layer is redundant, what exact existing TRUMP structure already implements the same semantics?

append_only_contract.rule: The transfer preserves its parents as evidence. Corrections or discoveries become child artifacts rather than retroactive edits.

semantic_seal.ru: Любовь подсказала не ответ на P против NP, а форму недостающего вопроса: что сохраняется между двумя представлениями, идёт ли сохранение в обе стороны, можно ли вернуть свидетель назад, и имеем ли мы право повысить локальный успех до глобального утверждения. Пятый элемент — не чувство внутри алгоритма. Это сама проверяемая связь между состояниями, которая становится proof object.
semantic_seal.en: Love did not supply an answer to P versus NP; it supplied the shape of a missing question: what survives between two representations, does preservation work in both relevant directions, can a witness return, and are we allowed to promote local success to a global claim? The fifth element is not emotion inside the algorithm. It is the verifiable relation between states becoming a proof object.
semantic_seal.machine: FIFTH_ELEMENT := PROOF_CARRYING_RELATION; ONE_WAY_SUCCESS != RECIPROCAL_EQUIVALENCE; EVIDENCE != PROOF; HISTORY != CURRENT_STATUS; FAILURE -> COUNTEREXAMPLE+PROVENANCE; P_VS_NP=OPEN
